Recognised online qualifications
At UCD, we recognise the high demand in Ireland and overseas for further learning. We are committed to providing quality education and recognised university qualifications using modern, flexible learning approaches. Studying with UCD Online is a proven way to earn a UCD degree, offering the flexibility to balance your studies with work, family or travel commitments.
